landing.hero_subtitle: Write hardware tests in natural language. OqlOS converts them to executable scenarios for pumps, sensors, valves, and PLCs.
landing.hero_subtitle_variant_a: Your operators write hardware tests in 3 lines. No programmers. No licenses. On Raspberry Pi for €49.
landing.hero_subtitle_variant_b: Replace Cypress and Postman with one DSL. API + GUI + Hardware — zero code, 100% auditable.
landing.hero_subtitle_variant_c: GxP-compliant test automation. IEC 62353, EN 137, full audit trail. From €49/month.
landing.hero_subtitle_variant_d: Tell us what you want — we'll do it. 'Restart staging' → docker compose restart. NLP → OQL → Execution.
landing.hero_subtitle_full: Automatyzacja testów sprzętu przemysłowego w deklaratywnym DSL. Uruchom na Dockerze, Raspberry Pi lub w chmurze — od aparatów oddechowych po systemy IoT.
landing.arch_desc: Deklaratywny DSL → Parser → Interpreter → Hardware Abstraction → Modbus/GPIO/I²C. Uruchom lokalnie, na Raspberry Pi lub jako serwis Docker.
landing.editor_title: Write and edit OQL / TestQL scenarios
landing.editor_desc: Interactive editor with syntax highlighting. Choose an example or write your own scenario. Supports both .oql (hardware) and .iql/.tql (API/GUI) files.
landing.install_desc: Choose target platform. Docker for quick start, pip for integration, RPi for production test nodes.
landing.api_desc: FastAPI with automatic OpenAPI documentation. Scenarios, execution, hardware — everything via HTTP.
landing.plans_desc: Start for free with open-source core. Scale to device fleet with Pro or Enterprise.
landing.ecosystem_desc: OQL controls hardware (valves, pumps, sensors). TestQL/IQL tests API and GUI. Together they cover the entire pipeline: from pressure test to certification report.
landing.oql_feature_desc: Describe what you want to check — not how. Control existing hardware without code: Modbus valves, pumps, sensors. Versioned in Git, readable by operators.
landing.testql_feature_title: TestQL/IQL — API & GUI in One DSL
landing.testql_feature_desc: Replace Cypress and Postman. Test REST APIs, navigate GUIs, control hardware encoders. Zero code, 100% auditable syntax anyone can read.
landing.docker_feature_desc: One command and you have full production stack: API, IDE, reverse proxy with TLS. Dev and prod ready. No complex setup required.
landing.rpi_feature_desc: Run on €49 hardware at the test site. Connects to central API, handles sensors and devices directly. Perfect for distributed test fleets.
landing.rest_api_feature_desc: Stream results live to your applications. Control everything via HTTP: scenarios, execution, hardware identification. Server-Sent Events included.
landing.rports_feature_desc: Generate certification protocols (EN 137, GxP), PDF reports, CSV exports. Full audit trail stored. Integrates with ERP/LIMS systems.
